messages:
incident-bot: :warning: Elevated 5xx rate detected for service 'model-runner' in eu-central-1. 5m error rate = 22%. p95 latency rising. Alert: ALERT-1978881234
samira: I'm oncall, taking this. Kicking off triage. Any recent infra/runtime changes in region?
ryan_ops: There was a runtime push at 12:30UTC that enabled fused-attention kernels and a new cudnn bump on the cluster nodes.
samira: Pulling pod status...
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=model-runner -o wide
model-runner-7c9b2   0/1  CrashLoopBackOff   4   5m   10.20.1.11
model-runner-2f1d9   1/1  Running              0   10m  10.20.1.12
```
jen.t: On the crashing pods: kernel logs show segfaults inside fused_attention.so and repeated OOM kills.
```
[2026-04-02T12:45:02Z] model-runner[2219]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f8c...fused_attention.so +0x2f4
[2026-04-02T12:45:02Z] kernel: Killed process 2219 (model-runner) total-vm: 12345678kB
```
ryan_ops: GPU memory on host ec2-12-34-56-78: 100% used, multiple runner processes pinned to GPU 1. Fragmentation looks high.
samira: Hypothesis: the fused-attention kernel regression + cudnn change increases peak allocation on some sequences and trips OOM/segfault. Need immediate customer impact mitigation and then rollback or config toggle.
alex.k: Can we divert traffic to a smaller/quantized variant and reduce batch size?
samira: Yes, initiating traffic shift and scaling. Commands:
```
rwctl traffic set --service model-runner --region eu-central-1 --model textgen-v3-small-quant --weight 100
rwctl config set --service model-runner --region eu-central-1 --env INFER_BATCH_SIZE=1 --env FUSED_ATTENTION=false
rwctl capacity add --pool eu-central-gpu --count 3
```
devops-bot: Scale request submitted id=scale-euc-1978881234; expected new instances in ~4m
support-lead: Notifying customers with impacted requests >1% error for last 10m. Draft sent to affected customer list.
jen.t: After traffic shift and reducing batch size, metrics: 5xx dropped from 22% -> 2.1% within 3m. p95 latency rose ~120ms but within SLO for most customers.
ryan_ops: Captured core dumps and nv-smi logs; uploading to s3://incidents-prod/eu/1978881234/artifacts/
samira: Rolling back runtime change in region: disabling fused-attention flag in daemonset and redeploying nodes with previous cudnn. Steps: 1) patch runtime-config to disable fused kernels 2) cordon & drain affected nodes then restart model-runner pods
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap/runtime-config --patch '{"data":{"FUSED_ATTENTION":"false"}}'
for node in node-123 node-124; do kubectl cordon $node && kubectl drain $node --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data && ssh $node sudo systemctl restart runtime-agent; done
```
alex.k: Rollback applied. New pods come up healthy. No segfaults observed in the last 12m on restarted nodes. 5xx back to baseline ~0.4%.
jen.t: Root stack shows null-deref in fused_attention path when certain KV-cache flushes overlap with batch eviction. Looks like a race introduced by the fused kernel change.
samira: Action items: 1) eng-runtime to revert fused-kernel merge and cut hotfix. 2) Add e2e memory-pressure tests and long-context stress tests. 3) Improve canary gating for fused kernels (longer canary with mem profiling). 4) Add automatic routing fallback to quant small variant when region 5xx > 5% for >3m.
support-lead: Sent follow-up update to customers describing mitigation and ETA for full fix. Offering credits for requests impacted.
ryan_ops: Uploaded artifacts: s3://incidents-prod/eu/1978881234/artifacts/{coredump.tar.gz,nvidia-smi.log,journalctl.log}
samira: Creating ticket INC-1978881234 in jira, assigning to eng-runtime and eng-qe. Please include replication steps and add regression test owner.
alex.k: I'll take postmortem and own next steps. Handoff at 18:00 CEST to alex.k acknowledged.
incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated. Severity: Sev2. Duration: 55 minutes. Links: jira://INC-1978881234, runbook://gpu-memory-oom
samira: Good job team. Please paste any leftover notes into the ticket and close once RCA and customer communication are complete. :thumbsup:
